purpose: Prospective matched CT-E versus CE-E objective training under a new common all-special-token target mask
common_mask_policy: all_tokenizer_special_ids_immutable; exclude_special_tokens=false in the corruption alphabet
initialization_policy: fresh common MDLM50k EMA; fresh optimizer and EMA; identical model construction and seed; no V7 continuation
execution_policy: CT then CE, same GPU count, stop after any failure, never automatically retry or resume
memory_measurement: External NVIDIA snapshots every 2 seconds; observed aggregate GPU use includes other processes and is not allocator peak memory
follow_up: Review all training outcomes; no automatic molecular evaluation or longer experiment
